rule.text: According to the experts and shadowing notes, the most common mistake is applying ₹500 as the price tolerance without checking 1% of the line value first (this is how colleagues describe it in practice, not the rule itself). [1] A line that fails is held with exception PRICE_VAR and sent to the buyer who raised the PO, who either amends the PO or asks the supplier for a credit note. [3] If the tolerance shown on the variance panel differs from the SOP v4.0 rule (lower of 1% and ₹500 per line), report it to your Team Lead. [4]
